gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Sol-Ark 15K, EG4 FlexBOSS21 and EG4 12000XP are all 12 kW inverters when running on battery alone. On that common basis the Sol-Ark costs about $479 per battery-only kW, against about $300 for the FlexBOSS21 and $175 for the 12000XP. The Sol-Ark is also the only one of the three with a published surge length that holds 2× its battery-only rating for 10 s; the 6000XP's 2× surge lasts about 3.5 s.
standout_why: ecosolarkits.com/blogs/guides/eg4-vs-sol-ark (cited) already gives battery-only output for both hybrids (FlexBOSS21 12 kW, Sol-Ark 15K 12 kW). It also has a footnote saying surge durations differ by brand (0.5 s, 10 s, 10 min), but it shows the FlexBOSS21 surge only as 'see spec sheet' and has no prices or idle draw. currentconnected.com/eg4-inverters (cited) has EG4 prices and the FlexBOSS21's 12 kW battery-only figure, but nothing for Sol-Ark, no surge and no idle draw. liveoffthegrid.com/specs/inverters (rank 1, not cited) has idle watts (Sol-Ark 15K 90 W, 6000XP 50 W), but it lists the Sol-Ark at its 15,000 W with-solar figure as if it were continuous, with no battery-only split. signaturesolarsolutions.com (rank 8) has worst-case idle watts for the EG4 models only. None of them puts price and idle draw on a battery-only, per-day basis, or gives surge as a multiple of output with its duration. The pieces are spread across rival pages, so the finding is mostly arithmetic on figures they already publish.
decides: This confirms the cheaper picks and weakens the case for the Sol-Ark. ChatGPT's cards frame the Sol-Ark 15K as '15 kW' and the FlexBOSS21 as '16 kW', but both figures need solar running. On battery at night, all three larger units deliver 12 kW. The Sol-Ark's $2,150 premium over the FlexBOSS21 buys a documented 10 s surge (24 kVA), 200 A pass-through and 275 A battery current. It also brings the highest published idle draw: 90 W, about 2.2 kWh/day. For an off-grid buyer, the 12000XP gives the same 12 kW on battery for $175/kW, with no export. Its surge is unpublished, so a motor-start claim cannot be compared.
